@[simp] lemma Add.positive_iff [L.Add] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (add.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Add.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Mul.positive_iff [L.Mul] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (mul.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Exp.positive_iff [L.Exp] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (exp.operator ![t]).Positive ↔ t.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Exp.term_eq, bv_func]

section npow

def npow (L : Language) [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L] (n : ℕ) : Operator L 1 :=
  Operator.Mul.mul.foldr (One.one.comp ![]) (List.replicate n (bvar 0))

variable [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L]


lemma npow_zero : npow L 0 = One.one.comp ![] := rfl

lemma npow_succ : npow L (n + 1) = Operator.Mul.mul.comp ![npow L n, bvar 0] := rfl

def npow (L : Language) [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L] (n : ℕ) : Operator L 1 :=
  Operator.Mul.mul.foldr (One.one.comp ![]) (List.replicate n (bvar 0))

variable [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L]


lemma npow_zero : npow L 0 = One.one.comp ![] := rfl

lemma npow_succ : npow L (n + 1) = Operator.Mul.mul.comp ![npow L n, bvar 0] := rfl

end npow

@[simp] lemma npow_positive_iff [Operator.One L] [L.Mul] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    ((Operator.npow L k).operator ![t]).Positive ↔ k = 0 ∨ t.Positive := by
  cases k <;> simp [positive_operator_iff, operator_comp, npow_zero, npow_succ]
  case succ k _ =>
    simp [Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact h 1 0 (by simp [bvar])
    · intro h _ _ _
      exact h

Next, using the lemma \( \text{Semiterm.Operator.Zero.zero} \), we confirm that \( \text{Language.Zero.zero} \) is indeed the zero of type \( \text{Semiterm.Operator.Orth L} \). This ensures that the operator behaves as expected.

Continuing with the simplification, we utilize the lemma \( \text{val_func} \) to verify that the function from \( L \) to \( M \) preserves the structure, ensuring that our operations remain valid within the structure \( M \).

The lemma \( \text{Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂} \) assures us that the equivalence between functions and vectors holds, making our operations consistent across equivalent representations.

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))
  (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (f.foldr z (o :: os)).operator v = f.operator ![(f.foldr z os).operator v, o.operator v] := by
  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Semantics.Semantics
import Foundation.Vorspiel.NotationClass

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))
  (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (f.foldr z (o :: os)).operator v = f.operator ![(f.foldr z os).operator v, o.operator v] := by
  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

def iterr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : (n : ℕ) → Operator L n
  | 0     => z
  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

@[simp] lemma iterr_zero (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : f.iterr z 0 = z := rfl

section numeral

protected class Zero (L : Language) where
  zero : Semiterm.Const L

protected class One (L : Language) where
  one : Semiterm.Const L

protected class Add (L : Language) where
  add : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Mul (L : Language) where
  mul : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Exp (L : Language) where
  exp : Semiterm.Operator L 1

protected class Sub (L : Language) where
  sub : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Div (L : Language) where
  div : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Star (L : Language) where
  star : Semiterm.Const L

class GoedelNumber (L : Language) (α : Type*) where
  goedelNumber : α → Semiterm.Const L

notation "op(0)" => Zero.zero

notation "op(1)" => One.one

notation "op(+)" => Add.add

notation "op(*)" => Mul.mul

instance [L.Zero] : Operator.Zero L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Zero.zero ![]⟩⟩

instance [L.One] : Operator.One L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.One.one ![]⟩⟩

instance [L.Add] : Operator.Add L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Mul] : Operator.Mul L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Mul.mul Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Exp] : Operator.Exp L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Exp.exp Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Star] : Operator.Star L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Star.star ![]⟩⟩

lemma Zero.term_eq [L.Zero] : (@Zero.zero L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Zero.zero ![] := rfl

lemma One.term_eq [L.One] : (@One.one L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.One.one ![] := rfl

lemma Add.term_eq [L.Add] : (@Add.add L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Mul.term_eq [L.Mul] : (@Mul.mul L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Mul.mul Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Exp.term_eq [L.Exp] : (@Exp.exp L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Exp.exp Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Star.term_eq [L.Star] : (@Star.star L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Star.star ![] := rfl

open Language Semiterm

def numeral (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L] : ℕ → Const L
  | 0     => Zero.zero
  | n + 1 => Add.add.foldr One.one (List.replicate n One.one)

variable [hz : Operator.Zero L] [ho : Operator.One L] [ha : Operator.Add L]

lemma numeral_zero : numeral L 0 = Zero.zero := by rfl

lemma numeral_one : numeral L 1 = One.one := by rfl

lemma numeral_succ (hz : z ≠ 0) : numeral L (z + 1) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L z, One.one] := by
  simp [numeral]
  cases' z with z
  · simp at hz
  · rfl

lemma numeral_add_two : numeral L (z + 2) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L (z + 1), One.one] :=
  numeral_succ (by simp)

protected abbrev encode (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L]
    {α : Type*} [Encodable α] (a : α) : Semiterm.Const L :=
  Semiterm.Operator.numeral L (Encodable.encode a)

end numeral

@[simp] lemma Add.positive_iff [L.Add] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (add.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Add.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Mul.positive_iff [L.Mul] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (mul.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Exp.positive_iff [L.Exp] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (exp.operator ![t]).Positive ↔ t.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Exp.term_eq, bv_func]

section npow

def npow (L : Language) [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L] (n : ℕ) : Operator L 1 :=
  Operator.Mul.mul.foldr (One.one.comp ![]) (List.replicate n (bvar 0))

variable [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L]


lemma npow_zero : npow L 0 = One.one.comp ![] := rfl

lemma npow_succ : npow L (n + 1) = Operator.Mul.mul.comp ![npow L n, bvar 0] := rfl

end npow

@[simp] lemma npow_positive_iff [Operator.One L] [L.Mul] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    ((Operator.npow L k).operator ![t]).Positive ↔ k = 0 ∨ t.Positive := by
  cases k <;> simp [positive_operator_iff, operator_comp, npow_zero, npow_succ]
  case succ k _ =>
    simp [Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact h 1 0 (by simp [bvar])
    · intro h _ _ _
      exact h

namespace GoedelNumber

variable {α} [GoedelNumber L α]

abbrev goedelNumber' (a : α) : Semiterm L ξ n := const (goedelNumber a)

instance : GoedelQuote α (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨goedelNumber'⟩

def ofEncodable [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L] {α : Type*} [Encodable α] : GoedelNumber L α := ⟨Operator.encode L⟩

end GoedelNumber

end Operator

section complexity

variable {L : Language}

@[simp] lemma complexity_zero [L.Zero] : ((Operator.Zero.zero : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n).complexity = 1 := by
  simp [Operator.const, Operator.operator, Operator.numeral, Operator.Zero.term_eq, complexity_func]

@[simp] lemma complexity_one [L.One] : ((Operator.One.one : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n).complexity = 1 := by
  simp [Operator.const, Operator.operator, Operator.numeral, Operator.One.term_eq, complexity_func]

@[simp] lemma complexity_add [L.Add] (t u : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Operator.Add.add.operator ![t, u]).complexity = max t.complexity u.complexity + 1 := by
  simp [Operator.const, Operator.operator, Operator.numeral, Operator.Add.term_eq, complexity_func, Rew.func]
  simp [show (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) = {0, 1} from by ext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero]]

@[simp] lemma complexity_mul [L.Mul] (t u : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Operator.Mul.mul.operator ![t, u]).complexity = max t.complexity u.complexity + 1 := by
  simp [Operator.const, Operator.operator, Operator.numeral, Operator.Mul.term_eq, complexity_func, Rew.func]
  simp [show (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) = {0, 1} from by ext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero]]

end complexity

  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))

  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

content_full:
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Semantics.Semantics
import Foundation.Vorspiel.NotationClass

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))
  (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (f.foldr z (o :: os)).operator v = f.operator ![(f.foldr z os).operator v, o.operator v] := by
  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

def iterr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : (n : ℕ) → Operator L n
  | 0     => z
  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

@[simp] lemma iterr_zero (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : f.iterr z 0 = z := rfl

section numeral

protected class Zero (L : Language) where
  zero : Semiterm.Const L

protected class One (L : Language) where
  one : Semiterm.Const L

protected class Add (L : Language) where
  add : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Mul (L : Language) where
  mul : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Exp (L : Language) where
  exp : Semiterm.Operator L 1

protected class Sub (L : Language) where
  sub : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Div (L : Language) where
  div : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Star (L : Language) where
  star : Semiterm.Const L

class GoedelNumber (L : Language) (α : Type*) where
  goedelNumber : α → Semiterm.Const L

notation "op(0)" => Zero.zero

notation "op(1)" => One.one

notation "op(+)" => Add.add

notation "op(*)" => Mul.mul

instance [L.Zero] : Operator.Zero L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Zero.zero ![]⟩⟩

instance [L.One] : Operator.One L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.One.one ![]⟩⟩

instance [L.Add] : Operator.Add L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Mul] : Operator.Mul L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Mul.mul Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Exp] : Operator.Exp L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Exp.exp Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Star] : Operator.Star L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Star.star ![]⟩⟩

lemma Zero.term_eq [L.Zero] : (@Zero.zero L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Zero.zero ![] := rfl

lemma One.term_eq [L.One] : (@One.one L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.One.one ![] := rfl

lemma Add.term_eq [L.Add] : (@Add.add L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Mul.term_eq [L.Mul] : (@Mul.mul L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Mul.mul Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Exp.term_eq [L.Exp] : (@Exp.exp L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Exp.exp Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Star.term_eq [L.Star] : (@Star.star L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Star.star ![] := rfl

open Language Semiterm

def numeral (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L] : ℕ → Const L
  | 0     => Zero.zero
  | n + 1 => Add.add.foldr One.one (List.replicate n One.one)

variable [hz : Operator.Zero L] [ho : Operator.One L] [ha : Operator.Add L]

lemma numeral_zero : numeral L 0 = Zero.zero := by rfl

lemma numeral_one : numeral L 1 = One.one := by rfl

lemma numeral_succ (hz : z ≠ 0) : numeral L (z + 1) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L z, One.one] := by
  simp [numeral]
  cases' z with z
  · simp at hz
  · rfl

lemma numeral_add_two : numeral L (z + 2) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L (z + 1), One.one] :=
  numeral_succ (by simp)

protected abbrev encode (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L]
    {α : Type*} [Encodable α] (a : α) : Semiterm.Const L :=
  Semiterm.Operator.numeral L (Encodable.encode a)

end numeral

@[simp] lemma Add.positive_iff [L.Add] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (add.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Add.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Mul.positive_iff [L.Mul] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (mul.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Exp.positive_iff [L.Exp] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (exp.operator ![t]).Positive ↔ t.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Exp.term_eq, bv_func]

section npow

def npow (L : Language) [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L] (n : ℕ) : Operator L 1 :=
  Operator.Mul.mul.foldr (One.one.comp ![]) (List.replicate n (bvar 0))

variable [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L]


lemma npow_zero : npow L 0 = One.one.comp ![] := rfl

lemma npow_succ : npow L (n + 1) = Operator.Mul.mul.comp ![npow L n, bvar 0] := rfl

end npow

@[simp] lemma npow_positive_iff [Operator.One L] [L.Mul] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    ((Operator.npow L k).operator ![t]).Positive ↔ k = 0 ∨ t.Positive := by
  cases k <;> simp [positive_operator_iff, operator_comp, npow_zero, npow_succ]
  case succ k _ =>
    simp [Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact h 1 0 (by simp [bvar])
    · intro h _ _ _
      exact h

namespace GoedelNumber

variable {α} [GoedelNumber L α]

abbrev goedelNumber' (a : α) : Semiterm L ξ n := const (goedelNumber a)

instance : GoedelQuote α (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨goedelNumber'⟩

def ofEncodable [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L] {α : Type*} [Encodable α] : GoedelNumber L α := ⟨Operator.encode L⟩

end GoedelNumber

  simp [Operator.const, Operator.operator, Operator.numeral, Operator.Add.term_eq, complexity_func, Rew.func]

informal_statement: We introduce a class `LE` that defines a natural ordering relation `le` on a set `M`. This relation satisfies three key properties: reflexivity, transitivity, and a form of completeness in ordering.
informal_proof:
To establish that the `LE` relation on the set `M` satisfies the properties of reflexivity, transitivity, and completeness, we proceed as follows:

1. **Reflexivity**: For any element `a` in `M`, `a` is always less than or equal to itself. This is a fundamental property ensuring that every element is comparable to itself.

2. **Transitivity**: If `a` is less than or equal to `b`, and `b` is less than or equal to `c`, then `a` must also be less than or equal to `c`. This property ensures consistency in the ordering across elements.

3. **Completeness**: For any two elements `a` and `b` in `M`, either `a` is less than or equal to `b`, or `a` is not less than `b`. This ensures a total ordering where any two elements can be compared without exception.

These properties together define a well-behaved total ordering on the set `M`, establishing the `LE` relation as a reliable and consistent natural ordering relation.

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k

  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

content_full:
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Semantics.Semantics
import Foundation.Vorspiel.NotationClass

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))
  (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (f.foldr z (o :: os)).operator v = f.operator ![(f.foldr z os).operator v, o.operator v] := by
  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

def iterr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : (n : ℕ) → Operator L n
  | 0     => z
  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

@[simp] lemma iterr_zero (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : f.iterr z 0 = z := rfl

section numeral

protected class Zero (L : Language) where
  zero : Semiterm.Const L

protected class One (L : Language) where
  one : Semiterm.Const L

protected class Add (L : Language) where
  add : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Mul (L : Language) where
  mul : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Exp (L : Language) where
  exp : Semiterm.Operator L 1

protected class Sub (L : Language) where
  sub : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Div (L : Language) where
  div : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Star (L : Language) where
  star : Semiterm.Const L

class GoedelNumber (L : Language) (α : Type*) where
  goedelNumber : α → Semiterm.Const L

notation "op(0)" => Zero.zero

notation "op(1)" => One.one

notation "op(+)" => Add.add

notation "op(*)" => Mul.mul

instance [L.Zero] : Operator.Zero L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Zero.zero ![]⟩⟩

instance [L.One] : Operator.One L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.One.one ![]⟩⟩

instance [L.Add] : Operator.Add L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Mul] : Operator.Mul L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Mul.mul Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Exp] : Operator.Exp L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Exp.exp Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Star] : Operator.Star L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Star.star ![]⟩⟩

lemma Zero.term_eq [L.Zero] : (@Zero.zero L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Zero.zero ![] := rfl

lemma One.term_eq [L.One] : (@One.one L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.One.one ![] := rfl

lemma Add.term_eq [L.Add] : (@Add.add L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Mul.term_eq [L.Mul] : (@Mul.mul L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Mul.mul Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Exp.term_eq [L.Exp] : (@Exp.exp L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Exp.exp Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Star.term_eq [L.Star] : (@Star.star L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Star.star ![] := rfl

open Language Semiterm

def numeral (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L] : ℕ → Const L
  | 0     => Zero.zero
  | n + 1 => Add.add.foldr One.one (List.replicate n One.one)

variable [hz : Operator.Zero L] [ho : Operator.One L] [ha : Operator.Add L]

lemma numeral_zero : numeral L 0 = Zero.zero := by rfl

lemma numeral_one : numeral L 1 = One.one := by rfl

lemma numeral_succ (hz : z ≠ 0) : numeral L (z + 1) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L z, One.one] := by
  simp [numeral]
  cases' z with z
  · simp at hz
  · rfl

lemma numeral_add_two : numeral L (z + 2) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L (z + 1), One.one] :=
  numeral_succ (by simp)

protected abbrev encode (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L]
    {α : Type*} [Encodable α] (a : α) : Semiterm.Const L :=
  Semiterm.Operator.numeral L (Encodable.encode a)

end numeral

@[simp] lemma Add.positive_iff [L.Add] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (add.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Add.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Mul.positive_iff [L.Mul] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (mul.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Exp.positive_iff [L.Exp] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (exp.operator ![t]).Positive ↔ t.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Exp.term_eq, bv_func]

section npow

def npow (L : Language) [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L] (n : ℕ) : Operator L 1 :=
  Operator.Mul.mul.foldr (One.one.comp ![]) (List.replicate n (bvar 0))

variable [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L]


lemma npow_zero : npow L 0 = One.one.comp ![] := rfl

lemma npow_succ : npow L (n + 1) = Operator.Mul.mul.comp ![npow L n, bvar 0] := rfl

end npow

@[simp] lemma npow_positive_iff [Operator.One L] [L.Mul] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    ((Operator.npow L k).operator ![t]).Positive ↔ k = 0 ∨ t.Positive := by
  cases k <;> simp [positive_operator_iff, operator_comp, npow_zero, npow_succ]
  case succ k _ =>
    simp [Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact h 1 0 (by simp [bvar])
    · intro h _ _ _
      exact h

namespace GoedelNumber

variable {α} [GoedelNumber L α]

abbrev goedelNumber' (a : α) : Semiterm L ξ n := const (goedelNumber a)

instance : GoedelQuote α (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨goedelNumber'⟩

def ofEncodable [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L] {α : Type*} [Encodable α] : GoedelNumber L α := ⟨Operator.encode L⟩

end GoedelNumber

end Operator

section complexity

variable {L : Language}

@[simp] lemma complexity_zero [L.Zero] : ((Operator.Zero.zero : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n).complexity = 1 := by
  simp [Operator.const, Operator.operator, Operator.numeral, Operator.Zero.term_eq, complexity_func]

@[simp] lemma complexity_one [L.One] : ((Operator.One.one : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n).complexity = 1 := by
  simp [Operator.const, Operator.operator, Operator.numeral, Operator.One.term_eq, complexity_func]

@[simp] lemma complexity_add [L.Add] (t u : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Operator.Add.add.operator ![t, u]).complexity = max t.complexity u.complexity + 1 := by
  simp [Operator.const, Operator.operator, Operator.numeral, Operator.Add.term_eq, complexity_func, Rew.func]
  simp [show (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) = {0, 1} from by ext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero]]

@[simp] lemma complexity_mul [L.Mul] (t u : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Operator.Mul.mul.operator ![t, u]).complexity = max t.complexity u.complexity + 1 := by
  simp [Operator.const, Operator.operator, Operator.numeral, Operator.Mul.term_eq, complexity_func, Rew.func]
  simp [show (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) = {0, 1} from by ext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero]]

end complexity

abbrev linearOrderOfSTO (r) [IsStrictTotalOrder α r] [DecidableRel r] : LinearOrder α :=
  let hD : DecidableRel (fun x y => x = y ∨ r x y) := fun x y => decidable_of_iff (¬r y x)

    le_total := fun x y =>

informal_statement: The `LT` class in Lean4 is designed to define a strict linear ordering on a type `M`. It achieves this by establishing an equivalence between the result of applying a specific operator (`.LT.!.val`) to a list `[a, b]` and the standard less-than comparison `a < b` between two elements `a` and `b` of type `M`.
informal_proof:
The `LT` class encapsulates the concept of a strict linear order by leveraging an equivalence relation. Here’s how it works:

1. **Equivalence Definition**: For any two elements `a` and `b` of type `M`, the class asserts that `a` is less than `b` if and only if the operator `.LT.!.val` applied to the list `[a, b]` yields true.
   
2. **Reflexivity and Irreflexivity**: Since `.LT.!.val` represents a strict ordering, it inherently prohibits `a` from being equal to `b` when `a` is considered less than `b`, ensuring irreflexivity.

3. **Transitivity**: In a strict linear order, if `a < b` and `b < c`, then `a < c` must hold true. This transitivity is naturally satisfied by the equivalence defined within the `LT` class.

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Semantics.Semantics
import Foundation.Vorspiel.NotationClass

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))
  (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (f.foldr z (o :: os)).operator v = f.operator ![(f.foldr z os).operator v, o.operator v] := by
  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

def iterr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : (n : ℕ) → Operator L n
  | 0     => z
  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

@[simp] lemma iterr_zero (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : f.iterr z 0 = z := rfl

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Semantics.Semantics
import Foundation.Vorspiel.NotationClass

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))
  (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (f.foldr z (o :: os)).operator v = f.operator ![(f.foldr z os).operator v, o.operator v] := by
  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

def iterr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : (n : ℕ) → Operator L n
  | 0     => z
  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

@[simp] lemma iterr_zero (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : f.iterr z 0 = z := rfl

section numeral

protected class Zero (L : Language) where
  zero : Semiterm.Const L

protected class One (L : Language) where
  one : Semiterm.Const L

protected class Add (L : Language) where

protected class Mul (L : Language) where

protected class Exp (L : Language) where
  exp : Semiterm.Operator L 1

protected class Sub (L : Language) where

protected class Div (L : Language) where

protected class Star (L : Language) where

class GoedelNumber (L : Language) (α : Type*) where

notation "op(0)" => Zero.zero

notation "op(1)" => One.one

notation "op(+)" => Add.add

notation "op(*)" => Mul.mul

instance [L.Zero] : Operator.Zero L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Zero.zero ![]⟩⟩

instance [L.One] : Operator.One L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.One.one ![]⟩⟩

instance [L.Add] : Operator.Add L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Mul] : Operator.Mul L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Mul.mul Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Exp] : Operator.Exp L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Exp.exp Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Star] : Operator.Star L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Star.star ![]⟩⟩

lemma Zero.term_eq [L.Zero] : (@Zero.zero L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Zero.zero ![] := rfl

lemma One.term_eq [L.One] : (@One.one L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.One.one ![] := rfl

lemma Add.term_eq [L.Add] : (@Add.add L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Mul.term_eq [L.Mul] : (@Mul.mul L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Mul.mul Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Exp.term_eq [L.Exp] : (@Exp.exp L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Exp.exp Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Star.term_eq [L.Star] : (@Star.star L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Star.star ![] := rfl

open Language Semiterm

def numeral (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L] : ℕ → Const L
  | 0     => Zero.zero
  | n + 1 => Add.add.foldr One.one (List.replicate n One.one)

variable [hz : Operator.Zero L] [ho : Operator.One L] [ha : Operator.Add L]

lemma numeral_zero : numeral L 0 = Zero.zero := by rfl

lemma numeral_one : numeral L 1 = One.one := by rfl

lemma numeral_succ (hz : z ≠ 0) : numeral L (z + 1) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L z, One.one] := by
  simp [numeral]
  cases' z with z
  · simp at hz
  · rfl

lemma numeral_add_two : numeral L (z + 2) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L (z + 1), One.one] :=
  numeral_succ (by simp)

protected abbrev encode (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L]
    {α : Type*} [Encodable α] (a : α) : Semiterm.Const L :=
  Semiterm.Operator.numeral L (Encodable.encode a)

end numeral

@[simp] lemma Add.positive_iff [L.Add] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (add.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Add.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Mul.positive_iff [L.Mul] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (mul.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Exp.positive_iff [L.Exp] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (exp.operator ![t]).Positive ↔ t.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Exp.term_eq, bv_func]

informal_proof:
To establish that the `Eq` class provides a valid equality definition, we need to verify that it satisfies the properties of an equivalence relation: reflexivity, symmetry, and transitivity.

1. **Reflexivity**: For any element `a` of type `M`, `a` is equal to itself. This follows directly from the definition of equality, as `L`'s equivalence condition is trivially satisfied when `a` and `b` are the same.

2. **Symmetry**: If `a` is equal to `b` under `L`'s equivalence condition, then `b` must also be equal to `a`. Since the condition is based solely on the properties of `a` and `b`, the direction of equality does not affect the satisfaction of `L`.

3. **Transitivity**: If `a` is equal to `b` and `b` is equal to `c` under `L`'s equivalence condition, then `a` must also be equal to `c`. This holds because if `a`, `b`, and `c` all satisfy the conditions laid out by `L`, then `a` and `c` naturally satisfy `L` as well.

Thus, the `Eq` class successfully defines an equivalence relation on `M`, ensuring that the notion of equality respects the structure imposed by `L`.

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))

  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Semantics.Semantics
import Foundation.Vorspiel.NotationClass

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))
  (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (f.foldr z (o :: os)).operator v = f.operator ![(f.foldr z os).operator v, o.operator v] := by
  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

def iterr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : (n : ℕ) → Operator L n
  | 0     => z
  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

@[simp] lemma iterr_zero (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : f.iterr z 0 = z := rfl

section numeral

protected class Zero (L : Language) where
  zero : Semiterm.Const L

protected class One (L : Language) where
  one : Semiterm.Const L

protected class Add (L : Language) where
  add : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Mul (L : Language) where
  mul : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Exp (L : Language) where
  exp : Semiterm.Operator L 1

protected class Sub (L : Language) where
  sub : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Div (L : Language) where
  div : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Star (L : Language) where
  star : Semiterm.Const L

class GoedelNumber (L : Language) (α : Type*) where
  goedelNumber : α → Semiterm.Const L

notation "op(0)" => Zero.zero

notation "op(1)" => One.one

notation "op(*)" => Mul.mul

instance [L.One] : Operator.One L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.One.one ![]⟩⟩

instance [L.Add] : Operator.Add L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Mul] : Operator.Mul L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Mul.mul Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Exp] : Operator.Exp L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Exp.exp Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

instance [L.Star] : Operator.Star L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Star.star ![]⟩⟩

lemma Zero.term_eq [L.Zero] : (@Zero.zero L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Zero.zero ![] := rfl

lemma One.term_eq [L.One] : (@One.one L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.One.one ![] := rfl

lemma Add.term_eq [L.Add] : (@Add.add L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Mul.term_eq [L.Mul] : (@Mul.mul L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Mul.mul Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Exp.term_eq [L.Exp] : (@Exp.exp L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Exp.exp Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Star.term_eq [L.Star] : (@Star.star L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Star.star ![] := rfl

open Language Semiterm

def numeral (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L] : ℕ → Const L
  | 0     => Zero.zero
  | n + 1 => Add.add.foldr One.one (List.replicate n One.one)

variable [hz : Operator.Zero L] [ho : Operator.One L] [ha : Operator.Add L]

lemma numeral_zero : numeral L 0 = Zero.zero := by rfl

lemma numeral_one : numeral L 1 = One.one := by rfl

lemma numeral_succ (hz : z ≠ 0) : numeral L (z + 1) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L z, One.one] := by
  simp [numeral]
  cases' z with z
  · simp at hz
  · rfl

lemma numeral_add_two : numeral L (z + 2) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L (z + 1), One.one] :=
  numeral_succ (by simp)

protected abbrev encode (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L]
    {α : Type*} [Encodable α] (a : α) : Semiterm.Const L :=
  Semiterm.Operator.numeral L (Encodable.encode a)

end numeral

@[simp] lemma Add.positive_iff [L.Add] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (add.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Add.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Mul.positive_iff [L.Mul] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (mul.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Exp.positive_iff [L.Exp] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (exp.operator ![t]).Positive ↔ t.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Exp.term_eq, bv_func]

section npow

def npow (L : Language) [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L] (n : ℕ) : Operator L 1 :=
  Operator.Mul.mul.foldr (One.one.comp ![]) (List.replicate n (bvar 0))

variable [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L]


lemma npow_zero : npow L 0 = One.one.comp ![] := rfl

lemma npow_succ : npow L (n + 1) = Operator.Mul.mul.comp ![npow L n, bvar 0] := rfl

end npow

@[simp] lemma npow_positive_iff [Operator.One L] [L.Mul] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    ((Operator.npow L k).operator ![t]).Positive ↔ k = 0 ∨ t.Positive := by
  cases k <;> simp [positive_operator_iff, operator_comp, npow_zero, npow_succ]
  case succ k _ =>
    simp [Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact h 1 0 (by simp [bvar])
    · intro h _ _ _
      exact h

namespace GoedelNumber

variable {α} [GoedelNumber L α]

abbrev goedelNumber' (a : α) : Semiterm L ξ n := const (goedelNumber a)

instance : GoedelQuote α (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨goedelNumber'⟩

def ofEncodable [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L] {α : Type*} [Encodable α] : GoedelNumber L α := ⟨Operator.encode L⟩

end GoedelNumber

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Semantics.Semantics
import Foundation.Vorspiel.NotationClass

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))
  (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (f.foldr z (o :: os)).operator v = f.operator ![(f.foldr z os).operator v, o.operator v] := by
  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

def iterr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : (n : ℕ) → Operator L n
  | 0     => z
  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

@[simp] lemma iterr_zero (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : f.iterr z 0 = z := rfl

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Semantics.Semantics
import Foundation.Vorspiel.NotationClass

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))
  (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (f.foldr z (o :: os)).operator v = f.operator ![(f.foldr z os).operator v, o.operator v] := by
  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

def iterr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : (n : ℕ) → Operator L n
  | 0     => z
  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

@[simp] lemma iterr_zero (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : f.iterr z 0 = z := rfl

section numeral

protected class Zero (L : Language) where
  zero : Semiterm.Const L

protected class One (L : Language) where
  one : Semiterm.Const L

protected class Add (L : Language) where
  add : Semiterm.Operator L 2

protected class Mul (L : Language) where

  exp : Semiterm.Operator L 1

instance [L.Add] : Operator.Add L := ⟨⟨Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar⟩⟩

lemma Zero.term_eq [L.Zero] : (@Zero.zero L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Zero.zero ![] := rfl

lemma One.term_eq [L.One] : (@One.one L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.One.one ![] := rfl

lemma Add.term_eq [L.Add] : (@Add.add L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Add.add Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Mul.term_eq [L.Mul] : (@Mul.mul L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Mul.mul Semiterm.bvar := rfl

lemma Star.term_eq [L.Star] : (@Star.star L _).term = Semiterm.func Language.Star.star ![] := rfl

open Language Semiterm

def numeral (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L] : ℕ → Const L
  | 0     => Zero.zero
  | n + 1 => Add.add.foldr One.one (List.replicate n One.one)

variable [hz : Operator.Zero L] [ho : Operator.One L] [ha : Operator.Add L]

lemma numeral_zero : numeral L 0 = Zero.zero := by rfl

lemma numeral_one : numeral L 1 = One.one := by rfl

lemma numeral_succ (hz : z ≠ 0) : numeral L (z + 1) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L z, One.one] := by
  simp [numeral]
  cases' z with z
  · simp at hz
  · rfl

lemma numeral_add_two : numeral L (z + 2) = Operator.Add.add.comp ![numeral L (z + 1), One.one] :=
  numeral_succ (by simp)

protected abbrev encode (L : Language) [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L]
    {α : Type*} [Encodable α] (a : α) : Semiterm.Const L :=
  Semiterm.Operator.numeral L (Encodable.encode a)

end numeral

@[simp] lemma Add.positive_iff [L.Add] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (add.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Add.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Mul.positive_iff [L.Mul] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (mul.operator ![t, u]).Positive ↔ t.Positive ∧ u.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
  exact ⟨by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, h 1⟩,
    by intro h i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [Fin.eq_zero, *]⟩

@[simp] lemma Exp.positive_iff [L.Exp] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (exp.operator ![t]).Positive ↔ t.Positive := by
  simp [positive_operator_iff, Exp.term_eq, bv_func]

section npow

def npow (L : Language) [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L] (n : ℕ) : Operator L 1 :=
  Operator.Mul.mul.foldr (One.one.comp ![]) (List.replicate n (bvar 0))

variable [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L]


lemma npow_zero : npow L 0 = One.one.comp ![] := rfl

lemma npow_succ : npow L (n + 1) = Operator.Mul.mul.comp ![npow L n, bvar 0] := rfl

end npow

@[simp] lemma npow_positive_iff [Operator.One L] [L.Mul] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    ((Operator.npow L k).operator ![t]).Positive ↔ k = 0 ∨ t.Positive := by
  cases k <;> simp [positive_operator_iff, operator_comp, npow_zero, npow_succ]
  case succ k _ =>
    simp [Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact h 1 0 (by simp [bvar])
    · intro h _ _ _
      exact h

abbrev goedelNumber' (a : α) : Semiterm L ξ n := const (goedelNumber a)

instance : GoedelQuote α (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨goedelNumber'⟩

def ofEncodable [Operator.Zero L] [Operator.One L] [Operator.Add L] {α : Type*} [Encodable α] : GoedelNumber L α := ⟨Operator.encode L⟩

informal_statement: Let $L$, $M$, and $N$ be sets equipped with a pointwise multiplication structure as defined by `class_mul`. For any three elements $a \in L$, $b \in M$, and $c \in N$, the multiplication operation is associative, i.e., $a \cdot (b \cdot c) = (a \cdot b) \cdot c$.
informal_proof:
To establish the associativity of the multiplication operation defined by `class_mul`, we consider three arbitrary elements $a \in L$, $b \in M$, and $c \in N$. Our goal is to demonstrate that the multiplication operation satisfies $a \cdot (b \cdot c) = (a \cdot b) \cdot c$.

1. **Understanding Pointwise Multiplication**: The operation `a.mul b` is defined as the pointwise multiplication of $L$ and $M$ through the method `Pointwise.casesOn` and `rev Griff` functions. This operation applies multiplication element-wise between elements of $L$ and $M$.

2. **Applying Associativity of Scalar Multiplication**: Since each element of $L$, $M$, and $N$ inherits the properties of scalar multiplication from the standard multiplication over the real numbers, which is known to be associative. Therefore, the associativity property propagates to these product structures.

3. **Detailed Proof**:
   - Compute $a \cdot (b \cdot c)$:
     - First, evaluate $b \cdot c$ as $b_i \cdot c_i$ for each index $i$.
     - Then, compute $a \cdot (b \cdot c)$ as $a_j \cdot (b_i \cdot c_i)$ for each corresponding index.
   - Compute $(a \cdot b) \cdot c$:
     - First, evaluate $a \cdot b$ as $a_j \cdot b_i$ for each $i$.
     - Then, compute $(a \cdot b) \cdot c$ as $(a_j \cdot b_i) \cdot c_i$.
   - Since scalar multiplication is associative, $a_j \cdot (b_i \cdot c_i) = (a_j \cdot b_i) \cdot c_i$ for all indices $i$ and $j$.
   - Therefore, $a \cdot (b \cdot c) = (a \cdot b) \cdot c$ holds true for all elements $a$, $b$, and $c$ in $L$, $M$, and $N$, respectively.

This concludes the proof of associativity for the multiplication operation defined by `class_mul`.

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Semantics.Semantics

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))
  (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (f.foldr z (o :: os)).operator v = f.operator ![(f.foldr z os).operator v, o.operator v] := by
  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

def iterr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : (n : ℕ) → Operator L n
  | 0     => z
  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

@[simp] lemma iterr_zero (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : f.iterr z 0 = z := rfl

  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

  | n + 1 => Add.add.foldr One.one (List.replicate n One.one)

lemma numeral_zero : numeral L 0 = Zero.zero := by rfl

  simp [numeral]

  · simp at hz
  · rfl

def npow (L : Language) [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L] (n : ℕ) : Operator L 1 :=
  Operator.Mul.mul.foldr (One.one.comp ![]) (List.replicate n (bvar 0))

variable [Operator.One L] [Operator.Mul L]


lemma npow_zero : npow L 0 = One.one.comp ![] := rfl

lemma npow_succ : npow L (n + 1) = Operator.Mul.mul.comp ![npow L n, bvar 0] := rfl

end npow

@[simp] lemma npow_positive_iff [Operator.One L] [L.Mul] (t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    ((Operator.npow L k).operator ![t]).Positive ↔ k = 0 ∨ t.Positive := by
  cases k <;> simp [positive_operator_iff, operator_comp, npow_zero, npow_succ]
  case succ k _ =>
    simp [Mul.term_eq, bv_func]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact h 1 0 (by simp [bvar])
    · intro h _ _ _
      exact h

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Semantics.Semantics
import Foundation.Vorspiel.NotationClass

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi x hx ↦ h x i hi hx, fun h x i hi hx ↦ h i hi x hx⟩

@[simp] lemma positive_const (c : Const L) : (c : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)).Positive := by simp [const, positive_operator_iff]

-- f.operator ![ ... f.operator ![f.operator ![z, t 0], t 1], ... ,t (n-1)]
def foldr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : List (Operator L k) → Operator L k
  | []      => z
  | o :: os => f.comp ![foldr f z os, o]

@[simp] lemma foldr_nil (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) : f.foldr z [] = z := rfl

@[simp] lemma operator_foldr_cons (f : Operator L 2) (z : Operator L k) (o : Operator L k) (os : List (Operator L k))
  (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (f.foldr z (o :: os)).operator v = f.operator ![(f.foldr z os).operator v, o.operator v] := by
  simp [foldr, operator_comp, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂]

def iterr (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : (n : ℕ) → Operator L n
  | 0     => z
  | _ + 1 => f.foldr (bvar 0) (List.ofFn fun x => bvar x.succ)

@[simp] lemma iterr_zero (f : Operator L 2) (z : Const L) : f.iterr z 0 = z := rfl

  simp [numeral]

  · simp at hz

  simp [positive_operator_iff, Add.term_eq, bv_func]

@[simp] lemma Mul.positive_iff [L.Mul] (t u : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :

  simp [positive_operator_iff, Exp.term_eq, bv_func]

informal_statement: In a monoid where both left and right multiplicative identities exist, the identity element is uniquely one.
informal_proof:
First, we establish that in a monoid, the left and right identities must coincide, resulting in a uniquely defined two-sided identity element. In this context, we denote this identity by **1**. 

To confirm that **1** serves as a proper multiplicative identity, we verify its behavior under the monoid operation. Specifically, for any element **a** in the monoid, multiplying **a** by **1** from both the left and the right should return **a** itself.

By applying the dialog-solving tactics provided, we ensure that **1** maintains this identity property in both directions. The `rfl` tactic confirms the reflexivity of equality, ensuring that **1** indeed behaves as the identity element when applied to any other element in the monoid. Additionally, since the monoid operation is associative and closed under the set of elements, **1** remains consistent and unique as the identity.

Thus, we conclude that in such a monoid, the identity element is necessarily one, fulfilling all the properties required for a well-defined multiplicative monoid identity.

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Semantics.Semantics
import Foundation.Vorspiel.NotationClass

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language}

namespace Semiterm

structure Operator (L : Language) (n : ℕ) where
  term : Semiterm L Empty n

abbrev Const (L : Language.{u}) := Operator L 0

def fn {k} (f : L.Func k) : Operator L k := ⟨Semiterm.func f (#·)⟩

namespace Operator

def equiv : Operator L n ≃ Semiterm L Empty n where
  toFun := Operator.term
  invFun := Operator.mk
  left_inv := by intro _; simp
  right_inv := by intro _; simp

def operator {arity : ℕ} (o : Operator L arity) (v : Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) : Semiterm L ξ n :=
  Rew.substs v (Rew.emb o.term)

@[coe] abbrev const (c : Const L) : Semiterm L ξ n := c.operator ![]

instance : Coe (Const L) (Semiterm L ξ n) := ⟨Operator.const⟩

def comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) : Operator L l :=
  ⟨o.operator (fun x => (w x).term)⟩

@[simp] lemma operator_comp (o : Operator L k) (w : Fin k → Operator L l) (v : Fin l → Semiterm L ξ n) :
  (o.comp w).operator v = o.operator (fun x => (w x).operator v) := by
    simp [operator, comp, ←Rew.comp_app]; congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]; contradiction

def bvar (x : Fin n) : Operator L n := ⟨#x⟩

lemma operator_bvar (x : Fin k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : (bvar x).operator v = v x := by
  simp [operator, bvar]

lemma bv_operator {k} (o : Operator L k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)) :
    (o.operator v).bv = .biUnion o.term.bv fun i ↦ (v i).bv  := by
  simp [operator]
  generalize o.term = s
  induction s <;> try simp [Rew.func, bv_func, Finset.biUnion_biUnion, *]
  case fvar => contradiction

lemma positive_operator_iff {k} {o : Operator L k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    (o.operator v).Positive ↔ ∀ i ∈ o.term.bv, (v i).Positive := by
  simp [Positive, bv_operator]

informal_statement: For every natural number \( n \), there exists a prime number \( p \) such that \( p > n \). Equivalently, there are infinitely many primes.
informal_proof:
First, let \( n \) be an arbitrary natural number. Consider the number \( (n + 1)! + 1 \). Since \( n + 1 \geq 2 \), \( (n + 1)! \) is at least 2, making \( (n + 1)! + 1 \geq 3 \), which ensures that \( (n + 1)! + 1 \) is greater than 2.

Next, by the fundamental theorem of arithmetic, every integer greater than 1 has a prime factor. Therefore, \( (n + 1)! + 1 \) has at least one prime factor \( p \). 

Assume, for the sake of contradiction, that \( p \leq n \). Since \( p \leq n \) and \( p \) is a prime factor of \( (n + 1)! \), it follows that \( p \) divides \( (n + 1)! \).

Additionally, \( p \) divides \( (n + 1)! + 1 \) by definition. Therefore, \( p \) must also divide the difference between \( (n + 1)! + 1 \) and \( (n + 1)! \), which is 1. 

However, if \( p \) divides 1, then \( p \) must be 1, which contradicts the fact that \( p \) is a prime number (primes are greater than 1). This contradiction implies that our initial assumption \( p \leq n \) is false. Therefore, \( p > n \).

Thus, for any natural number \( n \), there exists a prime number \( p \) such that \( p > n \). This demonstrates that the set of prime numbers is infinite.
